correctness.rationale: For 3|N=3n, Legendre/Kummer gives v2 binom(N,t)=s2(t)+s2(N-t)-s2(N). A binomial has valuation 0 precisely when t is a nonempty proper subset of the 1-bits of N; multiples of 3 are characterized by even-minus-odd bit-position counts modulo 3. When s2(N)>=4 an appropriate proper zero-sum bit subset exists. When weight=3 (all bits same parity), explicit t=2^i+2^(j-1) gives 1 carry. When weight=2 (one even, one odd), every admissible partition has total Hamming weight>=4, while the displayed construction reaches two carries. The n=1 empty gcd case is excluded. Independent direct integer-binomial GCD values checked for n=2..35, and independent Kummer digit-sum minima for n=2..300; inspected source verifier checks direct GCDs through n=200.
